question: A road is being proposed to facilitate a housing development on a scenic lake. Two alternatives have been suggested. One of the roadway alignments is to go around the lake  and slightly impact a wetland. The second alternative will also go around the lake and  will significantly impact two wetlands. The following table shows the anticipated costs  for each alternative. Assuming that the annual interestrate is 7 percent, determine which alternative is preferred using equivalent annual cost analysis.
